eligible_sql:
SELECT p.system technology,p.message,regexp_replace(p.path, '\[[0-9]+\]', '[*]', 'g') path,p.param_key,COALESCE(p.discriminators,'{}'::jsonb) discriminator,count(*) n_occurrences FROM param_occurrence p WHERE p.project_id=:pid AND p.origin='network_config' AND p.param_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_identifier,false)
AND regexp_replace(p.path,'^.*/','') !~ '^(spare[0-9]*|dummy|reserved)$'
AND p.path NOT IN ('systemFrameNumber','mib/systemFrameNumber') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5
